name: lineup-optimizer
description: Suggest the optimal batting order for your team using one of four sabermetric philosophies (modern, traditional, platoon, hot-hand), with career platoon splits and 30-day hot/cold trend data. Invoke when the user asks for a lineup, batting order, or lineup recommendation. The user's message may contain a team name, philosophy, handedness matchup, and/or players to exclude.
author: rwalker123
